question: Which hosted models of compute/alibaba-cloud-model carry a free quota for embedding and rerank, and does that record's card requirement hold for them?
why: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing (Singapore, International) lists a free quota of 1 million tokens, valid 90 days, for text-embedding-v4, tongyi-embedding-vision-plus, tongyi-embedding-vision-flash and qwen3-rerank (text-embedding-v3 has none); the record covers the quota generally and states a card.
